hunks:
The readiness response exposes `activeBlockerCount`, `resolvedBlockerCount` and `readinessTransitionCount` as complete current counts rather than embedding child histories. Workflow history responses use `items`, `nextCursor`, `hasMore`, `pageSize` and `isFirstPage`; `cursor` is an opaque string, limited to 4,096 characters. It is bound to Alliance, Plan, participant, history kind and blocker state. Invalid or mismatched tokens fail validation; every page requires current authority. Evidence and workflow histories load only when their panel is opened. Participant lists have their separate current-authorized 25-row pages and exact SQL totals; this is not a complete-plan eligibility assessment.

## Management collection endpoints

`GET /alliance/transfers/manage/catalogues/{kind}` accepts `cursor`, and the relevant `plan`/`group` identifiers. Kinds are plans, windows, cohorts, officialGroups, conditions, capacities and groupKingdoms. Each response is `{page, total}`; page uses the common PageSlice fields. Every request requires current Transfer Manage authority and the exact Alliance/plan/window binding.

`GET /alliance/transfers/manage/options/{kind}` supports windows, cohorts, members and roster with `q` (up to 160 characters), `cursor`, `selected` and relevant `plan`. It returns `{page, total, selected}`; selected is one currently valid `{id,name}` or null, independent of the search text. IDs for roster choices are roster IDs, not Governor IDs. Cursor length is bounded to 4,096 characters. Searches escape literal wildcard characters. Unknown kinds, malformed positions and cross-scope tokens fail validation.

`GET /alliance/transfers/manage?plan=<id>` inspects a retained, currently authorized Alliance plan. `selectedPlan` identifies the inspected plan; `mutablePlan` is populated only when that is the canonical mutable plan. Write routes and owner validation are unchanged. See [ADR-0053](../architecture/adr/0053-scoped-transfer-management-collections.md).
